No, that is not true.  

Cross‑border commuters (Grenzgänger) from the EU/EFTA can live anywhere in Switzerland and do not have to return home every day. The only requirement is that they return to their main residence abroad at least once a week. They are not restricted to specific “border zones” – they can reside in any municipality across the country while commuting to work in Switzerland.  

The legal basis is the Agreement on the Free Movement of Persons between the European Union and Switzerland, which grants EU/EFTA citizens the right to work and reside in Switzerland under the same conditions as Swiss citizens, subject to the weekly return requirement for commuters.
